svg.title: BCY17868_L6_M0 passenger U21–linker–handle connectivity
svg.desc: Two-dimensional depiction derived from the saved authoritative molecular graph. Contains passenger terminal U21 with its incoming phosphate, the attachment phosphate, the complete L6 connector and clicked triazole, and the complete residue-14 peptide handle. RNA and Peptide are continuation placeholders at two recorded cut bonds, not added caps. Teal bonds identify U21, violet identifies the connector/junction, and gold identifies the handle. The remaining RNA duplex and cyclic peptide are not drawn. No new three-dimensional model is generated.
